stories.title: The 10 Biggest Days in AI History
stories.take: The 10, in chronological order (the host declines to rank): OpenAI founded, Dec 11, 2015 • 'Attention Is All You Need' transformer paper, Jun 12, 2017 • ChatGPT launch, Nov 30, 2022 — 1M users in 5 days • OpenAI's board fires Sam Altman, Nov 17, 2023 • Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Jun 20, 2024 • DeepSeek shock — Nvidia loses $589B in one day, Jan 27, 2025 • Claude Opus 4.5 opens the agentic era, Nov 24, 2025 • Trump bans federal use of Anthropic, Feb 27, 2026 • Midterm data-center backlash, Nov 3, 2026 • Anthropic IPO day, today • Honorable mentions: Stable Diffusion, Nvidia's May 2023 earnings, o1 preview, Stargate, Jensen Huang's resignation

stories.title: Anthropic Pulls Off Historic IPO, But AI Doubts Remain
stories.take: Anthropic raised $81B — the largest IPO ever — opened above $111, then faded to close just above $97 for a $1.3T valuation; WSJ calls it a success that held above pricing • Big winners: Amazon, Google, and Lightspeed/Iconiq stakes worth $25B+; Anthropic now sits on roughly $200B in cash • All three indexes fell 2%+ as investors sold other tech to buy Anthropic — raising the question of what capital is left for OpenAI's IPO • The ICJ ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya — a first finding against a state • Commercial electricity use passes residential for the first time ever, driven by data centers

stories.title: "Drill, baby, drill” goes global
stories.take: After the Trump-Xi-Putin summit, the US, Russia and China pledged more refined-fuel supply — but US refineries already run at 96%, Russia's are war-damaged, and China keeps its spare capacity for itself: 'no there, there' • On Anthropic's IPO day the Dow still fell 1,101 points; Anthropic closed at $97, up 17% • The average new-car price has topped $50,000, with more than a quarter of buyers on seven-year-plus loans • Black unemployment at 6.6% and a falling job share for Black women flash warning signs under a calm headline labor market

stories.title: This relic of U.S. politics may be on its way out
stories.take: The relic is the Electoral College — and the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact could sideline it without a constitutional amendment • The compact takes effect at 270 electoral votes; it stands at 222 (18 states + DC), and five new Democratic-trifecta battlegrounds — PA, MI, WI, NV, AZ, about 61 votes — could put it over the top • Candidates would have to campaign for every vote instead of seven swing states, and supporters say turnout would rise • Hosts' bottom line: momentum is real, but legal challenges make an effect by 2028 very unlikely

stories.title: UC approves military equipment for UCLA, SoCal roads flood, Skydance TV merger — Evening Edition
stories.take: UC Regents approved UCLA police buying six more drones plus pepper-ball and 40mm foam rounds — the less-lethal rounds a federal judge banned LAPD from using this year • Storm fallout: rescues from flooded roads and washes, 2+ inches of rain in an hour in the San Fernando Valley, flood warnings now lifted • Riverside Sheriff Chad Bianco defends $3M in taxpayer-funded security that also covered campaign events • Skydance merges the Paramount and Warner Bros TV studios — 120+ active shows under one studio

stories.title: Cole's reopens under new ownership, Where to place Thanksgiving pre-orders, GTA VI release— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Cole's, downtown LA's 1908 French-dip icon, reopened under new owners Sean Maloney and Jeremy Fall — familiar room, updated dip at $26 • GTA VI lands to 99/100 on Metacritic after a decade of delays and the 2022 leak; about $1.6B already generated, 40M copies projected in four months • Thanksgiving pre-orders: Loria's Pie Bar and Gusto Bread by Friday; Panaderia La Mexicana's vegan tamales and pozole by Nov 22
